name: Dazzling Footwork
description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you gain the following benefits: Bardic Damage - you can use your Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack rolls of your Unarmed Strikes, and when you use an Unarmed Strike to deal damage, you can use a Bardic Inspiration die in place of the normal damage die. Unarmored Defense - your base Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier. Agile Strikes - when you expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of that action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
